title: An "I Can't Found Poem from Google" #clmooc #smallpoems
summary: I can't sleep I can't breath I can't stand the rain I can't I can't drive 55 I can't help myself I can't wait I can't stop loving you I can't get no satisfaction Why Can't I?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I can't sleep
I can't breath
I can't stand the rain
I can't

I can't drive 55
I can't help myself
I can't wait
I can't stop loving you
I can't get no satisfaction

Why Can't I?
